lines.en: I walk with folded knees, short strides.
My scales are a dark red.

lines.zh: 我用前爪扒地，一步步来
lines.en: I claw the ground and come forward.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，走起来不方便
lines.en: Wings folded, walking is awkward.
I keep low, as if stalking.
I drag my tail over a root.
Every three steps I halt.

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的石缝里挤过来
lines.en: I squeeze through the ruin's stone gaps.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在地上，很扁
lines.en: My shadow lies flat on the ground.
My claws leave prints in the soil.
I come at you without detouring.
Head low, eyes always up.
I crouch, neck pressed low.
Ash sits between my scales.
I listen to the echo off stone.
This is a Drakvyrn Hand ruin.

lines.zh: 我从古蛋里出来，回来这里
lines.en: I hatched from an ancient egg, and returned here.

lines.zh: 我把气含在喉里，一点声都不漏
lines.en: I keep my breath in my throat and let no sound out

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣着地面，随时能起
lines.en: My claws grip the ground, ready.
I need not fly; walking gets me there.
I try my wings, then fold them.

lines.zh: 这一带的气味我都记着
lines.en: I remember every smell here.
I raise my eyes to the ruin's doorway.
An old scar runs along my jaw.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫出来会引来人
lines.en: I do not roar; it would draw people.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖在地上轻轻敲
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground.
I raise my head, taller than you expected.
You have entered my ruin.

lines.zh: 我的脖子侧了一下，露出鳞
lines.en: I turn my neck, showing scales.
Let me look first; I'm in no hurry to open my jaws
There is iron in your smell.

lines.zh: 我当年也是被这样看着的
lines.en: I was looked at like this once.
I set my hind legs.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我认得那种光
lines.en: I know that shine in your hand.

lines.zh: 这片地是我的，我在这里出生
lines.en: This ground is mine; I was born here.

lines.zh: 我垂下脖子，让眼睛跟你齐平
lines.en: I lower my neck until my eyes are level with yours

lines.zh: 你退，我不追，但你别走远
lines.en: Retreat and I will not chase, but do not go far.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在你的光下发亮
lines.en: My scales shine in your light.

lines.zh: 你身上有古蛋的味道吗
lines.en: Do you carry the smell of the ancient egg?
I dislike anyone touching the stones.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，热气就出来了
lines.en: I open my mouth, and heat comes out.

lines.zh: 你要是想拿走什么，先过我
lines.en: To take anything, you go through me first.
Only a few paces of stone between us.

lines.zh: 你这张脸，我刻在脑子里了
lines.en: Your face is carved into my memory now
I give half a step, scales rattling.

lines.zh: 这一下打碎了我几片鳞
lines.en: That broke a few of my scales.

lines.zh: 我没有叫，只是低了低头
lines.en: I did not cry out; I only dipped my head.
Blood seeps between my scales.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我干脆贴到石面上
lines.en: That hit sends me flat against the stone floor

lines.zh: 翅膀自己抖起来，我压不住
lines.en: My wing shivers on its own; I can't hold it still
I have your strength now.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换你一条命也值
lines.en: This wound would be worth your life.
I back two steps around the pillar.
You think this is enough to win.

lines.zh: 肉是好的，但我先看你的手
lines.en: Meat is good, but I watch your hands first.

lines.zh: 这点东西，换不了我的蛋
lines.en: That will not buy my egg.

lines.zh: 鼻子贴上去，我嗅了两下
lines.en: Nose to it, I take two quick sniffs
You set it too close.

lines.zh: 我不扑，我等你手再近些
lines.en: I don't lunge; I wait for your hand to come closer
My teeth are long, so I eat slowly.

lines.zh: 这么小一块，塞牙缝都不够
lines.en: That scrap wouldn't even fill a gap between my teeth

lines.zh: 我吃了，你就能靠近一点
lines.en: Eat it, and you may come a little closer.

lines.zh: 手指头伸进来，就别想收回去
lines.en: Put a finger in there and you won't pull it back

lines.zh: 我退开，把东西留在原地
lines.en: I step back and leave it where it is.
You rush; I stay exactly where I am.

lines.zh: 我的鳞硬，撞上来你自己疼
lines.en: My scales are hard; the impact hurts you.
I turn and shoulder you aside.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的伏势打散了
lines.en: That broke my crouch.

lines.zh: 被顶退了，我又把重心贴回地面
lines.en: Knocked back, I settle my weight to the ground again

lines.zh: 相撞的声音压在石头间
lines.en: The impact lingers among the stones.

lines.zh: 翅膀被石壁夹住，我抽了抽
lines.en: My wing caught between the stones; I pull it free
I step back, then push in again.

lines.zh: 地上的石屑被我们踢起来
lines.en: Stone chips kick up around us.
You did not move me.
That requires beating me first.
Win, and the egg is yours.
That is the only rule I know.
When my kind meet, it is usually a fight.

lines.zh: 我不送东西，我只试力气
lines.en: I give no gifts; I test strength.
If you fall, I stop.
The egg is deep in the ruin; I keep it.
Take it and I will not follow.
This fight gives one chance.
I have your fighting style now.
I take it in my jaws and lift slowly.
Harder than scale, this.
I push it into a stone crack.
I lower my head and push with my snout.
I could not trade this for much.
It is stuck between my teeth.
I step on it and press.
This is lost; I do not pick it up.
I take it into the ruin.
My claws serve better than hands.

lines.zh: 你走进来了，就没人怪我了
lines.en: You came in; no one can blame me now.

lines.zh: 身子压进石缝，只剩眼睛露着
lines.en: My body is pressed into the crack with only my eyes showing
From here, one bite reaches you.

lines.zh: 再一步，你就进我的范围了
lines.en: One more step and you're inside my reach
The pillars will not stop me.
My hind legs are braced.
You are not the first to come in.
I smell your heart speeding up.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是给外面听的
lines.en: I do not roar; a roar is for those outside.

lines.zh: 爪子已经离开地面，我来了
lines.en: My claws have left the ground — here I come

lines.zh: 你退到门口，那里也是我的
lines.en: Retreat to the doorway; that is mine too.
This is my heaviest blow.
I box you between the pillars.
My tail presses the ground.
The ancient egg is behind me.
Only the last step remains.

lines.zh: 我压着肚皮，一路黏着你的脚
lines.en: Belly to the floor, I stick to your heels
You circle the pillars; so do I.
I need no flight; I am fast enough.
My claws scrape the stone.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，那里没有缝
lines.en: You back to a corner; no gap there.

lines.zh: 我停下，是因为在算距离
lines.en: I stop to measure the distance.
I am patient; the ruin has no exit.
My scent is in every crack.
When you look up, I press in.

lines.zh: 我喘一口气，石壁替我传出去
lines.en: I breathe once and the stone walls carry the sound

lines.zh: 你脚下的碎瓦响得很清楚
lines.en: The broken tiles rattle under you.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收起来，缩紧身体
lines.en: I draw my tail in and compress.
Last time: I lunge.
There is nowhere left for you.
You crack the tiles louder.
My scales have all lifted.
I wait for you to turn your back.

lines.zh: 耐性用完了，前爪开始扣地
lines.en: My patience is spent; my foreclaws dig into the floor
I bite down.
My foreclaw pins your shoulder.
I ram and press you down.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的护甲撕开了
lines.en: That tore your armor open.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，地上的瓦都飞了
lines.en: My tail sweeps; the tiles fly.

lines.zh: 我咬完抬头，把你甩出去
lines.en: I bite and throw you off.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，一股热气喷出来
lines.en: I open my mouth and a blast of heat comes out.
You are driven against a pillar.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，让你站起来
lines.en: I step back half a pace to let you rise.
I held nothing back.
The second bite is truer than the first.
There is iron in my teeth.
With a low growl I press in again.

lines.zh: 没倒？那我把牙再压深一点
lines.en: Still up? Then I'll sink my teeth deeper
I check my force and wait for you.

lines.zh: 爪印留在你胸前的甲上
lines.en: Claw marks remain on your chest plate.

lines.zh: 石缝里传出鳞片摩擦的声音
lines.en: Scales scrape against stone in the cracks.
I come up from deep in the ruin.

lines.zh: 我出生在这座龙之手的遗迹里
lines.en: I was born in this Drakvyrn Hand ruin.
Bits of the ancient eggshell still litter the floor.
I raise my head first to check for anyone.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在狭窄处展开不了
lines.en: My wings cannot open in this narrow place.

lines.zh: 灰尘从我的背上滑下去
lines.en: Dust slides off my back.
The air here is old.
I walk step by step to the doorway.
I smell something new.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，藏进阴影
lines.en: I lower my body into the shadow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留下第一道印
lines.en: My claws leave the first print.

lines.zh: 遗迹是我唯一认得的地方
lines.en: The ruin is the only place I know.
I circle the pillar halfway.

lines.zh: 我抬头，光从破口落下来
lines.en: I look up; light falls through the breach.

lines.zh: 我在这里等着，谁来都一样
lines.en: I wait here; anyone who comes is the same.
My tail sweeps the floor first.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的热气冒出来，我又咽回去
lines.en: Heat rises from my throat and I swallow it back down

lines.zh: 火对我不算什么，我只是不喜欢
lines.en: Fire is nothing to me; I simply dislike it.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上滚下去，鳞片磕响
lines.en: I tumble down the steps, scales clattering.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我猛抬头
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把碎瓦全掀到我身上
lines.en: The blast throws all the tiles into me.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的鳞缝里
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my scales.

lines.zh: 那股力让我的鳞片发烫
lines.en: That force heats my scales.
There is little to eat in this ruin.

lines.zh: 雷从破口打下来，我伏下
lines.en: Lightning comes through the breach; I flatten.

lines.zh: 底下空空的，遗迹也不见了
lines.en: Nothing below me, and the ruins are gone too
